title: Predicting the Thermodynamic Limits of Metal–Organic Framework Metastability
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society, 2026
description: We use density functional theory to compute the formation energy and construct convex hull phase diagrams for 20,000+ MOFs and coordination polymers, publishing novel analysis of metastability and synthesizeability, and benchmarking Generative-AI models and machine-learned interatomic potentials.

title: From Graphs to Transformers: A Review on Modern Architectures and Geometric Priors for Atomistic Machine Learning
description: A derivation of Transformer architectures starting from Geometric Deep Learning principles, surveying modern GNN designs and geometric priors for 3D atomic systems.
